hero.title: Put your brand on the fastest dirt in the islands.
hero.subtitle: Five legs across the Visayas and Mindanao. Every stage filmed, photographed and shared. Your logo on the cars, the start gantry and every screen in between.

footprint: Five host cities across two island groups — Ormoc, Tabogon, Iloilo, Bacolod and Bukidnon. One series, five local markets, one national story.

contentMachine.title: Video
contentMachine.text: Stage highlights, onboard footage and post-race recaps on Facebook and YouTube.

contentMachine.title: Photo
contentMachine.text: Professional photo coverage of every leg, with sponsor-branded galleries.

contentMachine.title: Social
contentMachine.text: Daily posts across race weeks: schedules, results, driver stories and partner shout-outs.

contentMachine.title: Influencers
contentMachine.text: Local creators and motoring personalities at the track, amplifying each leg.

contentMachine.title: Website
contentMachine.text: Your logo on every page of this site, ordered by tier, plus partner news features.
